# Intenter CLI reference

Intenter decides whether an AI coding agent may run a shell command,
based on what the command actually does rather than how it is spelled.

Every list and show command accepts `--json` for scripting.
Exit codes: `0` success, `1` error, `2` the daemon is unreachable.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`intenter approval`](intenter_approval.md) | Inspect and change one approval |
| [`intenter approval disable`](intenter_approval_disable.md) | Temporarily stop an approval from matching |
| [`intenter approval enable`](intenter_approval_enable.md) | Let a disabled approval match again |
| [`intenter approval revoke`](intenter_approval_revoke.md) | Permanently stop an approval from matching |
| [`intenter approval show`](intenter_approval_show.md) | Show everything one approval covers |
| [`intenter approvals`](intenter_approvals.md) | List what is trusted in this project |
| [`intenter approve`](intenter_approve.md) | Remember the effects of an evaluated command |
| [`intenter daemon`](intenter_daemon.md) | Run and manage the Intenter daemon |
| [`intenter daemon install`](intenter_daemon_install.md) | Register the per-user daemon service |
| [`intenter daemon restart`](intenter_daemon_restart.md) | Restart the daemon |
| [`intenter daemon run`](intenter_daemon_run.md) | Run the daemon in the foreground |
| [`intenter daemon start`](intenter_daemon_start.md) | Start the daemon in the background |
| [`intenter daemon status`](intenter_daemon_status.md) | Show daemon state |
| [`intenter daemon stop`](intenter_daemon_stop.md) | Stop the running daemon |
| [`intenter daemon uninstall`](intenter_daemon_uninstall.md) | Unregister the per-user daemon service |
| [`intenter doctor`](intenter_doctor.md) | Check the installation and suggest fixes |
| [`intenter history`](intenter_history.md) | Show what Intenter decided, and why |
| [`intenter history show`](intenter_history_show.md) | Explain one decision in full |
| [`intenter hook`](intenter_hook.md) | Handle an agent hook invocation (called by the agent, not by you) |
| [`intenter hook claude`](intenter_hook_claude.md) | Handle a Claude Code hook event read from stdin |
| [`intenter setup`](intenter_setup.md) | Install the Intenter integration for an agent |
| [`intenter setup claude`](intenter_setup_claude.md) | Detect Claude Code, install the hooks and start the daemon |
| [`intenter status`](intenter_status.md) | Show the daemon, integration and recent activity |
| [`intenter summary`](intenter_summary.md) | Count what Intenter decided, and how many prompts it answered for you |
| [`intenter uninstall`](intenter_uninstall.md) | Remove the Intenter integration for an agent |
| [`intenter uninstall claude`](intenter_uninstall_claude.md) | Remove Intenter's hooks and stop the daemon |
| [`intenter update`](intenter_update.md) | Check for a new release and install it |
| [`intenter update startup`](intenter_update_startup.md) | Manage the terminal start-up update check |
| [`intenter update startup disable`](intenter_update_startup_disable.md) | Remove the start-up check from your shell start-up files |
| [`intenter update startup enable`](intenter_update_startup_enable.md) | Add the start-up check to your shell start-up files |
| [`intenter update startup status`](intenter_update_startup_status.md) | Show where the start-up check is installed |
| [`intenter version`](intenter_version.md) | Print version, engine, protocol and schema versions |
